assets.title: Paired-Slot Slide Specimen Case
assets.description: One original static visual specimen-slide case with a continuous thick base and four walls, two continuous comb rails carrying six aligned pairs of true upward-open slots, and three original opaque blank rectangular plates seated in alternating slot pairs. Each plate has two complete finite lower-corner bearing patches; its entire central lower edge remains above the case floor. The other three slot pairs remain wholly empty. A single thick shallow-recessed lid is frozen rearward raised, supported by two true two-ear through-bore assemblies, continuous headed pins, complete ear pedestals and two finite angle stops. Original shell, rails, plates and lid geometry; no recoloured bait-box compartments, circular eyepiece holes, copied pipette fork or resized suitcase. One complete prop, not separate plate assets.
